limitations: Rendered DOM and host-semantic browser controls are audited; pixels inside a remotely rendered third-party page and screen-reader speech require separate human evaluation.
Computer frames and input ports are explicit fixtures; this proves rendered keyboard/ACK/Stop authority and denial UX, not OS permission or physical display capture.
